packs.title: En Familia
packs.description: Dichos, famosos, comida y cultura. Para jugar con todos, hasta con la abuela.
packs.descriptionEn: Sayings, celebrities, food and culture. Everyone can play, grandma included. Phrases are in Mexican Spanish.

packs.title: En Confianza
packs.description: Ya entrados en confianza: crudas, suegras, exes y uno que otro albur.
packs.descriptionEn: Once everybody loosens up: hangovers, in-laws, exes and the odd double entendre. Phrases are in Mexican Spanish.

packs.title: Sin Madre
packs.description: Sin nadie que te juzgue. Lenguaje muy fuerte, no apto para la comida del domingo.
packs.descriptionEn: Nobody here is judging. Very strong language, not for Sunday dinner. Phrases are in Mexican Spanish.

packs.title: Música y Artistas
packs.description: Cantantes, bandas, canciones y todo lo que suena.
packs.descriptionEn: Singers, bands, songs and everything that plays. Phrases are in Mexican Spanish.

packs.title: Whitexican
packs.description: Para los que dicen 'o sea' y pasan el finde en Valle.
packs.descriptionEn: For the ones who say 'o sea' and spend the weekend in Valle. Phrases are in Mexican Spanish.

packs.title: En Familia · España
packs.description: La misma mezcla, pero para jugar con la familia de España.
packs.descriptionEn: The same mix, written for family in Spain.
